caption: Mercy gives you another chance to leave the old life behind.

BSB.text: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.

KJV.text: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

caption: Everything changes. Christ doesn't.

BSB.text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

KJV.text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

caption: Grace isn't permission to keep sinning. Repent and turn back.

BSB.text: Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,

KJV.text: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

caption: Let Scripture correct you before a lie comforts you.

BSB.text: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.

KJV.text: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof [is] brutish.

caption: Waiting on God isn't doing nothing. It's refusing to run ahead of Him.

BSB.text: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
You, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the Lord’s coming is near.

KJV.text: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.

caption: Self-control is love with a backbone.

BSB.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

KJV.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

caption: Life gets simpler when Jesus gets the final word.

BSB.text: Why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ but do not do what I say?

KJV.text: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

caption: God is allowed to say no.

BSB.text: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.
But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.

KJV.text: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

caption: Holiness isn't a mood. It's how you live when the feeling is gone.

BSB.text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.

KJV.text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, [which is] your reasonable service.

caption: Pray before you react.

BSB.text: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.

KJV.text: Confess [your] faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

caption: Grace isn't an excuse to stay the same.

BSB.text: What then shall we say? Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase?
Certainly not! How can we who died to sin live in it any longer?

KJV.text: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

caption: The cross leaves very little room for pride.

BSB.text: But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

KJV.text: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

caption: Not every feeling deserves a decision.

BSB.text: He who trusts in himself is a fool, but one who walks in wisdom will be safe.

KJV.text: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

caption: Make the plan. Just don't confuse it with God's plan.

BSB.text: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.

KJV.text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

caption: Live today like eternity is real. It is.

BSB.text: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

KJV.text: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen [are] temporal; but the things which are not seen [are] eternal.

caption: Nobody may notice your obedience. God does.

BSB.text: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.

KJV.text: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.

caption: The flesh can make disobedience sound reasonable. Don't give it permission.

BSB.text: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

KJV.text: [This] I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

caption: People are here to be loved. Not used.

BSB.text: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”

KJV.text: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

caption: Stop trying to control what belongs to God.

BSB.text: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?

KJV.text: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

caption: Some days holiness looks painfully ordinary.

BSB.text: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;

KJV.text: For this is the will of God, [even] your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

caption: Do the small thing God asked. It matters more than it looks.

BSB.text: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.

KJV.text: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

caption: Old desires still knock. You don't have to open the door.

BSB.text: We know that our old self was crucified with Him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, that we should no longer be slaves to sin.

KJV.text: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with [him], that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

caption: Faith should still work when nobody is watching.

BSB.text: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.

KJV.text: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

caption: Being alone isn't the same as being abandoned. Christ is still there.

BSB.text: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”

KJV.text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, [even] unto the end of the world. Amen.

caption: Slow growth is still growth. Don't call it nothing.

BSB.text: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

KJV.text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform [it] until the day of Jesus Christ:

caption: God made ordinary things too. Not everything needs to be complicated.

BSB.text: For every creation of God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,

KJV.text: For every creature of God [is] good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

caption: Conviction can hurt and still be mercy.

BSB.text: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”

KJV.text: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

caption: Some days obeying God is boring. Do it anyway.

BSB.text: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.

KJV.text: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

caption: You don't own the outcome. Stop carrying it like you do.

BSB.text: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.

KJV.text: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring [it] to pass.

caption: Jesus didn't call anyone to admire the cross from a distance.

BSB.text: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

KJV.text: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.

caption: Prayer can be messy and honest. It's still prayer.

BSB.text: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.

KJV.text: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

caption: Forgive without pretending the trust was never broken.

BSB.text: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

KJV.text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also [do] ye.

caption: If God closed it, stop trying to pick the lock.

BSB.text: To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.

KJV.text: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

caption: Sometimes endurance is staying where obedience put you.

BSB.text: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.

KJV.text: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

caption: Do the boring thing again if obedience requires it.

BSB.text: Walk in the manner of the ant, O slacker; observe its ways and become wise.
Without a commander, without an overseer or ruler,
it prepares its provisions in summer; it gathers its food at harvest.

KJV.text: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
Provideth her meat in the summer, [and] gathereth her food in the harvest.

caption: Love can cost you something and still be the right choice.

BSB.text: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.

KJV.text: Hereby perceive we the love [of God], because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down [our] lives for the brethren.

caption: Pretending temptation isn't real doesn't make you mature.

BSB.text: So the one who thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall.

KJV.text: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.

caption: Holiness might reach parts of your life nobody can see. But God will.

BSB.text: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.

KJV.text: For the word of God [is] quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and [is] a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things [are] naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

caption: Before asking for another opinion, open Scripture.

BSB.text: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples.
Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”

KJV.text: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, [then] are ye my disciples indeed;
And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

caption: A faithful life is built one small yes at a time.

BSB.text: So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.

KJV.text: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

caption: Love the people you'd rather avoid.

BSB.text: For you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.

KJV.text: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only [use] not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

caption: You don't need revenge. Stop it. God sees the whole story.

BSB.text: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”

KJV.text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but [rather] give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance [is] mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

caption: Faith is proven in the dark. You're the light. Remember that.

BSB.text: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

KJV.text: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

caption: God can use the parts of life you'd rather hide.

BSB.text: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.

KJV.text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to [his] purpose.

caption: Obedience can feel like losing. Eternity changes what winning means.

BSB.text: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?

KJV.text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

caption: God usually gives enough light for the next step.

BSB.text: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.

KJV.text: But the path of the just [is] as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

caption: God doesn't owe you an explanation for every no.

BSB.text: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
“Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor?”

KJV.text: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable [are] his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counseller?

caption: There is no private part of life where Christ stops being Lord.

BSB.text: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.

KJV.text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, [do] all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

caption: Pride loses its grip when you confess it.

BSB.text: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.

KJV.text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

caption: Faith should survive boredom. Delay. Disappointment. Silence.

BSB.text: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.

KJV.text: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

caption: God can make a quiet life fruitful.

BSB.text: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.

KJV.text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

caption: Love is something you do. Not just something you feel.

BSB.text: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

KJV.text: Charity suffereth long, [and] is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

caption: Being yourself isn't permission to follow every impulse.

BSB.text: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.

KJV.text: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

caption: Obedience counts more when no one else knows about it.

BSB.text: “Be careful not to perform your righteous acts before men to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.

So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

KJV.text: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.

Therefore when thou doest [thine] alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

caption: Fear God first and other fears will start losing their place.

BSB.text: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

KJV.text: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

caption: God can be glorified in work that feels insignificant.

BSB.text: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.

KJV.text: And whatsoever ye do, do [it] heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

caption: Let Scripture tell you who you are. Don't be friends with the world.

BSB.text: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—

KJV.text: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, [even] to them that believe on his name:

caption: Bring both your weakness and your strength to Jesus.

BSB.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.

KJV.text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

caption: Some things called personality are really just pride.

BSB.text: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.

KJV.text: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all [of you] be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

caption: The cross shows how costly salvation really was.

BSB.text: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.

KJV.text: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, [as] silver and gold, from your vain conversation [received] by tradition from your fathers;
But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

caption: Obedience can look foolish from the outside. Obey anyway.

BSB.text: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

KJV.text: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

caption: What God puts in your hands was never meant to stop with you.

BSB.text: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.

KJV.text: As every man hath received the gift, [even so] minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

caption: Fear gets loud when you forget who is actually in charge.

BSB.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

KJV.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

caption: A clean conscience is worth more than being right in public.

BSB.text: The goal of our instruction is the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a sincere faith.

KJV.text: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and [of] a good conscience, and [of] faith unfeigned:

caption: The longer you walk with Jesus, the less room there is for fake repentance.

BSB.text: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

KJV.text: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to [our] father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

caption: Some of the holiest moments happen when nobody notices.

BSB.text: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

KJV.text: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites [are]: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

caption: Growth can be real and there can still be plenty left to change.

BSB.text: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,
for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”

KJV.text: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

caption: There is no shortcut to holiness.

BSB.text: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.

KJV.text: Follow peace with all [men], and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

caption: God has never needed your panic to accomplish His purposes.

BSB.text: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

KJV.text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

caption: Don't settle for looking spiritual. Belong to Christ.

BSB.text: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.

KJV.text: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will [my] Father honour.

caption: Honest prayer can admit what you don't want to do. He wants to hear it all.

BSB.text: Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will.”

KJV.text: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou [wilt].

caption: Some days the prayer is simple: God, help me obey.

BSB.text: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.

KJV.text: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with [my] whole heart.

caption: When keeping score feels easier, choose mercy.

BSB.text: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.

KJV.text: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

caption: Suffering doesn't have to make sense to keep from being wasted.

BSB.text: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.
Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

KJV.text: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
Knowing [this], that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
But let patience have [her] perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

caption: Following Jesus means today still counts.

BSB.text: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him,
rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

KJV.text: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, [so] walk ye in him:
Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

caption: Enjoy a good day without demanding that tomorrow match it.

BSB.text: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. In any and every situation I have learned the secret of being filled and being hungry, of having plenty and having need.

KJV.text: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, [therewith] to be content.
I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

caption: The work still matters even if nobody claps for it.

BSB.text: There is profit in all labor, but mere talk leads only to poverty.

KJV.text: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips [tendeth] only to penury.

caption: Some problems lose power when you stop letting them define you.

BSB.text: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,
and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.

KJV.text: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
And have put on the new [man], which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

caption: Freedom starts when you finally admit you were wrong.

BSB.text: He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.

KJV.text: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh [them] shall have mercy.

caption: Hope gets steadier when Christ matters more than circumstances.

BSB.text: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”

KJV.text: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

caption: Peace makes room for obedience but panic keeps asking questions.

BSB.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

KJV.text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

caption: Love can set a boundary without becoming hatred.

BSB.text: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

KJV.text: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
Yet count [him] not as an enemy, but admonish [him] as a brother.

caption: Some habits only look permanent because you keep feeding them.

BSB.text: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.

KJV.text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

caption: Not every thought that arrives deserves to stay.

BSB.text: We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

KJV.text: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

caption: The Holy Spirit isn't an accessory to your life. He's leading it.

BSB.text: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.

KJV.text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

caption: Being useful matters more than being noticed.

BSB.text: It shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
and whoever wants to be first among you must be your slave—
just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”

KJV.text: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

caption: The next faithful thing might be small. Do it anyway.

BSB.text: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
So if you have not been faithful with worldly wealth, who will entrust you with true riches?
And if you have not been faithful with the belongings of another, who will give you belongings of your own?

KJV.text: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true [riches]?
And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man’s, who shall give you that which is your own?

caption: Some friendships need honesty more than another polite conversation.

BSB.text: Better an open rebuke than love that is concealed.
The wounds of a friend are faithful, but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

KJV.text: Open rebuke [is] better than secret love.
Faithful [are] the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy [are] deceitful.

caption: An easy road isn't promised. A Lord worth following is.

BSB.text: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

KJV.text: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

caption: Jesus isn't asking for a polished version of you.

BSB.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.

KJV.text: The sacrifices of God [are] a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

caption: A setback doesn't have to become your identity.

BSB.text: We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.

KJV.text: [We are] troubled on every side, yet not distressed; [we are] perplexed, but not in despair;
Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

caption: Peace isn't the same as getting your way.

BSB.text: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls,
yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!

KJV.text: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither [shall] fruit [be] in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and [there shall be] no herd in the stalls:
Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

caption: Some of the strongest prayers are only a few honest words.

BSB.text: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.

KJV.text: The LORD [is] nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

caption: Generosity doesn't need an audience.

BSB.text: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

KJV.text: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

caption: The world rewards attention. Jesus teaches what deserves it.

BSB.text: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

KJV.text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

caption: You don't have to answer every accusation.

BSB.text: When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.

KJV.text: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed [himself] to him that judgeth righteously:

caption: Your reputation isn't worth your conscience.

BSB.text: In this hope, I strive always to maintain a clear conscience before God and man.

KJV.text: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and [toward] men.

caption: Humility doesn't need the last word.

BSB.text: When words are many, sin is unavoidable, but he who restrains his lips is wise.

KJV.text: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips [is] wise.

caption: Pride wants credit. Love wants the other person helped.

BSB.text: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.

KJV.text: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

caption: Some fears leave. Others show where you still don't trust God.

BSB.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.

KJV.text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

caption: God knows what you need before you finish explaining it.

BSB.text: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.

KJV.text: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.

caption: Integrity still matters when nobody is checking.

BSB.text: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the perversity of the faithless destroys them.

KJV.text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

caption: Stop spending your life protecting an image.

BSB.text: Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

KJV.text: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

caption: Remembering death doesn't mean being afraid to live.

BSB.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

KJV.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou [art] with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

caption: Loving God will cost you something. That shouldn't surprise you.

BSB.text: In the same way, any one of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be My disciple.

KJV.text: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.

caption: Finish the race without becoming what you left behind.

BSB.text: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

KJV.text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset [us], and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of [our] faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

caption: A delay isn't automatically a disaster.

BSB.text: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.

KJV.text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew [their] strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; [and] they shall walk, and not faint.

caption: Today has enough trouble. Stop borrowing tomorrow's.

BSB.text: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.

KJV.text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day [is] the evil thereof.

caption: Some mornings need this reminder: you are dust and Christ is Lord.

BSB.text: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.

KJV.text: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we [are] dust.

caption: Work hard. Just don't make work your identity.

BSB.text: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat—for He gives sleep to His beloved.

KJV.text: [It is] vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: [for] so he giveth his beloved sleep.

caption: Don't miss grace just because it looks ordinary.

BSB.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.

KJV.text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

caption: Get rich in what can't be taken from you.

BSB.text: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.
But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.

KJV.text: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

caption: Don't trade kindness for the chance to look impressive.

BSB.text: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.
Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.

KJV.text: [Let] nothing [be done] through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

caption: Some battles are won by walking away before pride gets involved.

BSB.text: To start a quarrel is to release a flood; so abandon the dispute before it breaks out.

KJV.text: The beginning of strife [is as] when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

caption: Seeing Christ clearly makes your own importance shrink.

BSB.text: He must increase; I must decrease.

KJV.text: He must increase, but I [must] decrease.

caption: Anger feels powerful until you look at what it's actually producing.

BSB.text: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.

KJV.text: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

caption: A life can look full and still be spiritually empty.

BSB.text: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.

KJV.text: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

caption: You don't need the whole road to know who to follow.

BSB.text: Then Jesus called the crowd to Him along with His disciples, and He told them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and for the gospel will save it.

KJV.text: And when he had called the people [unto him] with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.

caption: Scripture has a way of ruining excuses that once sounded reasonable.

BSB.text: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.

KJV.text: All scripture [is] given by inspiration of God, and [is] profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

caption: What you wanted can still be missing. Christ can still be enough.

BSB.text: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.
More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ

KJV.text: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

Yea doubtless, and I count all things [but] loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them [but] dung, that I may win Christ,

caption: God's timing doesn't need your anxiety attached to it.

BSB.text: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

KJV.text: My times [are] in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

caption: Correction can sting and still be worth listening to.

BSB.text: Listen to counsel and accept discipline, that you may be wise the rest of your days.

KJV.text: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

caption: Some desires need to be crucified, not followed.

BSB.text: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

KJV.text: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

caption: Leave room to be interrupted when someone needs love.

BSB.text: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.
Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:

KJV.text: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

caption: Let Scripture interrupt you.

BSB.text: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

KJV.text: For the word of God [is] quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and [is] a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

caption: Repentance doesn't need drama. Turn around.

BSB.text: Therefore, O house of Israel, I will judge you, each according to his ways, declares the Lord GOD. Repent and turn from all your transgressions, so that your iniquity will not become your downfall.

KJV.text: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Repent, and turn [yourselves] from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

caption: Being useful matters more than being seen.

BSB.text: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”

KJV.text: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

caption: Some comforts become chains so quietly they start feeling normal.

BSB.text: “Everything is permissible for me,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible for me,” but I will not be mastered by anything.

KJV.text: All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.

caption: You don't need every answer. You need to stay faithful.

BSB.text: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, so that we may follow all the words of this law.

KJV.text: The secret [things belong] unto the LORD our God: but those [things which are] revealed [belong] unto us and to our children for ever, that [we] may do all the words of this law.

caption: Love someone enough to tell the truth.

BSB.text: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.

KJV.text: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, [even] Christ:

caption: A delayed answer still asks you to trust God with the wait.

BSB.text: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning—more than watchmen wait for the morning.

KJV.text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
My soul [waiteth] for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: [I say, more than] they that watch for the morning.

caption: The boring disciplines are doing more than you can see.

BSB.text: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.

KJV.text: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

caption: Rest and escape aren't the same thing.

BSB.text: Better one handful with tranquility than two handfuls with toil and pursuit of the wind.

KJV.text: Better [is] an handful [with] quietness, than both the hands full [with] travail and vexation of spirit.

caption: You don't need everything to make sense to stay faithful.

BSB.text: But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”

KJV.text: But he said, Yea rather, blessed [are] they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

caption: Not every correction needs a defense. God may be using it.

BSB.text: He who listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise.
He who ignores discipline despises himself, but whoever heeds correction gains understanding.

KJV.text: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.

caption: Some days contentment is the miracle.

BSB.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

KJV.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD [is] my shepherd; I shall not want.

caption: Private victories matter more than public approval.

BSB.text: A Psalm of David. O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,

KJV.text: A Psalm of David. LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

caption: You don't have to feel ready to do what is right.

BSB.text: Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.

KJV.text: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth [it] not, to him it is sin.

caption: The goal isn't to become impressive. It's to become faithful.

BSB.text: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

KJV.text: He hath shewed thee, O man, what [is] good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

caption: Don't waste suffering by only asking when it will end.

BSB.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,
who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.

KJV.text: Blessed [be] God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

caption: Learn to receive correction without turning it into rejection.

BSB.text: As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.

KJV.text: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

caption: Following Jesus long enough means borrowed voices eventually fall away.

BSB.text: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.

KJV.text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

caption: Some things get clearer when you stop forcing an answer.

BSB.text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;

KJV.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

caption: Measure the day by faithfulness, not excitement.

BSB.text: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.

KJV.text: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast [some] of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

caption: Sometimes God answers pride with something you can't control.

BSB.text: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.

KJV.text: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

caption: Remember how much you've been forgiven before you choose bitterness.

BSB.text: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

KJV.text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also [do] ye.

caption: Love doesn't need to keep a ledger.

BSB.text: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.

KJV.text: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;

caption: Some things get beautiful after you stop rushing them.

BSB.text: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.

KJV.text: He hath made every [thing] beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

caption: Build habits that make obeying God easier, not harder.

BSB.text: But reject irreverent, silly myths. Instead, train yourself for godliness.
For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.

KJV.text: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself [rather] unto godliness.
For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

caption: The world keeps saying more. Jesus keeps saying enough.

BSB.text: And He said to them, “Watch out! Guard yourselves against every form of greed, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions.”

KJV.text: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

caption: Grace for today is enough for today.

BSB.text: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!

KJV.text: [It is of] the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
[They are] new every morning: great [is] thy faithfulness.

caption: Sometimes the next right thing is to forgive and keep walking.

BSB.text: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.

KJV.text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

caption: It takes courage to admit you need help.

BSB.text: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.
For if one falls down, his companion can lift him up; but pity the one who falls without another to help him up!

KJV.text: Two [are] better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him [that is] alone when he falleth; for [he hath] not another to help him up.

caption: Waiting doesn't have to become your identity.

BSB.text: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!

KJV.text: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

caption: Suffering doesn't make obedience optional.

BSB.text: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
perseverance, character; and character, hope.
And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.

KJV.text: And not only [so], but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

caption: Some prayers sound like requests but are really surrender.

caption: Giving up control isn't the same as giving up responsibility.

BSB.text: For each one should carry his own load.

KJV.text: For every man shall bear his own burden.

caption: Holiness is mostly built when nothing interesting is happening.

BSB.text: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.

KJV.text: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

caption: Who you become is built in choices nobody sees.

BSB.text: Do you not know that when you offer yourselves as obedient slaves, you are slaves to the one you obey, whether you are slaves to sin leading to death, or to obedience leading to righteousness?

KJV.text: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

caption: Conviction calls you back. Condemnation tells you to stay away.

BSB.text: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

KJV.text: [There is] therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

caption: A soft answer can take more strength than a sharp one.

BSB.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

KJV.text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

caption: Confess faster than you defend yourself.

BSB.text: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah

KJV.text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

caption: Joy grows when you stop needing to possess every good thing.

BSB.text: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.

KJV.text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

caption: Your tongue can build a house or burn one down before breakfast.

BSB.text: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.

KJV.text: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
And the tongue [is] a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.

caption: You don't need to manufacture meaning. Be faithful with today.

BSB.text: You must walk in all the ways that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.

KJV.text: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and [that it may be] well with you, and [that] ye may prolong [your] days in the land which ye shall possess.

caption: Some days the victory is simply refusing to become bitter.

BSB.text: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.

KJV.text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

caption: Faith can mean taking the next step with unanswered questions.

BSB.text: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.

KJV.text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

caption: Getting older should make a clean heart matter more than a crowded life.

BSB.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

KJV.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

caption: Sometimes the best use of a good day is giving it away.

BSB.text: In everything, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus Himself: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”

KJV.text: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

caption: Be careful when your heart always has a justification ready.

BSB.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.

KJV.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
And see if [there be any] wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

caption: Refuse it today so you don't have to regret it tomorrow.

BSB.text: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

KJV.text: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

caption: Enjoy creation without turning it into an idol.

BSB.text: They exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is forever worthy of praise! Amen.

KJV.text: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

caption: Some seasons are mostly pruning. That doesn't make them pointless.

BSB.text: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.

KJV.text: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every [branch] that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

caption: Your tongue reveals your heart faster than you think.

BSB.text: The good man brings good things out of the good treasure of his heart, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil treasure of his heart. For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.

KJV.text: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

caption: Spend less time managing appearances and more time tending your soul.

BSB.text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of dead men’s bones and every kind of impurity.
In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

KJV.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead [men’s] bones, and of all uncleanness.
Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

caption: What you repeat eventually shapes who you become.

BSB.text: But reject irreverent, silly myths. Instead, train yourself for godliness.

KJV.text: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself [rather] unto godliness.

caption: If strength only serves ambition, it's being wasted.

BSB.text: We who are strong ought to bear with the shortcomings of the weak and not to please ourselves.

KJV.text: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

caption: Some opportunities let you serve. Others only feed your ego.

BSB.text: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?

KJV.text: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels [of compassion] from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

caption: The world can be loud without getting the final say.

BSB.text: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.

KJV.text: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

caption: Freedom starts when you remember you aren't the center of the story.

BSB.text: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.

KJV.text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether [they be] thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

caption: A guarded heart isn't a closed heart. It knows what needs protecting.

BSB.text: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
Put away deception from your mouth; keep your lips from perverse speech.
Let your eyes look forward; fix your gaze straight ahead.
Make a level path for your feet, and all your ways will be sure.
Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your feet away from evil.

KJV.text: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it [are] the issues of life.
Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

caption: Keep your heart soft without becoming careless.

BSB.text: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.

KJV.text: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

caption: The right thing can still hurt.

BSB.text: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.

KJV.text: For [it is] better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

caption: Don't let one disappointment become a prophecy about your future.

BSB.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.

KJV.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my God.

caption: Strength can look like saying no without needing everyone to understand.

BSB.text: No, I discipline my body and make it my slave, so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified.

KJV.text: But I keep under my body, and bring [it] into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.

caption: Some days faith looks like doing the same good thing again.

BSB.text: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

KJV.text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

caption: A good heart still needs guarding.

BSB.text: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

KJV.text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

caption: God is present in the ordinary work you used to rush through.

BSB.text: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,

KJV.text: And whatsoever ye do, do [it] heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
